acceptanceCriteria: Each agent_cost reader enforces a byte and row bound and reports prose, non-object and over-bound input as a named invalid-observations class instead of raising; invalid rows are not copied verbatim into sealed receipts.

cw-trial and cem-trial bound the reply read before allocation, record stream truncation from StdoutOverflow in the report, keep ABSENT, MALFORMED and empty replies distinct, and refuse negative token counts.
dogfood-workers counts Codex usage only from the token-count record types, with a fixture containing an echoed usage object.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the V1-0712 output-class inventory (docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0712-output-class-inventory.md), source origin/main a2615609. Confirmed from source except where marked INFERRED; runtime NOT_RUN. Complements V1-0369, which owns the daily-loop-v0 savings semantics (unmatched arms, failed tasks, negative tokens). Remaining gaps: (1) agent_cost in daily-loop-v0, daily-loop-v1 and untouched-repository-v1 reads --agent-observations with [json.loads(l) for l in open(path)]: no byte, line or row bound, and a prose line raises an uncaught JSONDecodeError instead of a named class; v1 copies invalid rows verbatim into the sealed receipt and accepts fractional or huge token counts. (2) tools/cw-trial codexAgent.run reads the reply file with unbounded os.ReadFile (main.go:1332) before truncating to maxReplyBytes; runCommand (main.go:1455-1479) uses procgroup OverflowTruncate and never reads StdoutOverflow, so a truncated codex event stream is scored as complete; tools/cem-trial has the same pattern (main.go:1022). (3) parseCodexEvents keeps only the last turn.completed usage (INFERRED: multi-turn tokens lost), addTokens accepts negative values, claims JSON accepts unknown fields and duplicate keys, and cw-trial scores ABSENT, MALFORMED and empty replies all as abstained. (4) benchmarks/dogfood-workers parseCodex sums any record carrying a usage object regardless of record type (INFERRED: an echoed tool output with a usage object would be counted).
title: Benchmark and trial harnesses read agent replies and token telemetry without a byte bound or a malformed-row class
